The Mysterious Claws, Necrozma!'') is the 29th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{adv|Sun}} and {{adv|Moon}} defeat {{p|Stakataka}}. * Attracted by [[Nebby|Lunala]]'s aura, {{p|Necrozma}} separates from {{p|Solgaleo}} and attacks it. * [[Phyco]], the [[Ultra Recon Squad]]'s captain, arrives at the [[Poni Altar]] to take [[Lusamine]] to the [[Ultra Megalopolis]]. * Lusamine uses a [[Beast Ball]] to capture the {{p|Naganadel}} Phyco rode to [[Alola]]. * Moon's {{p|Grimer}} is revealed to have [[Evolution|evolved]] into a {{p|Muk}}. * Lusamine and Phyco arrive at the Ultra Megalopolis to capture Necrozma. * Angered by Sun's hatred of the [[Aether Foundation]], Lusamine sends out a {{p|Nihilego}} and has it fuse with her. {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * [[Phyco]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Naganadel}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Sun}} * {{adv|Moon}} * [[Anabel]] (flashback) * [[Lusamine]] * [[Zossie]] * [[Soliera]] * [[Phyco]] * {{tc|Aether Foundation Employee}}s ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Meowth}} ([[Alolan form]];
